identitySignals: Agenda text gives Richmond, CA; Alten Construction's headquarters is 1141 Marina Way South, Richmond, CA (company website contact page)

HKIT Architects' project page for the McClymonds High School Modernization names Alten Construction, Inc. as general contractor and Oakland Unified School District as client/owner, matching the agenda's design-builder team (Alten Construction with HKIT Architects, McClymonds High School Modernization)
Company is a general contractor that builds school projects, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' category
Agenda text spells the name 'Aten'; the official OUSD titles in the same record spell it 'Alten Construction, Inc.', so 'Aten' is treated as a typo
research.notes: The company website footer reads 'Alten Construction, LLC' while the agenda, HKIT and other directories use 'Alten Construction, Inc.'; legal form not verified against the California Secretary of State (not found via search). Contractor license #705713 shown on the website. No general email address published on the site. HKIT Architects is a separate design partner, not covered by this profile.

profile.summary: Alten Construction is a general contractor that builds projects in the San Francisco Bay Area. Its work includes commercial buildings, schools and other education projects, laboratories, historic building renovations, and seismic and structural upgrades.

sources.title: McClymonds High School Modernization - HKIT Architects

review.notes: Alten Construction (Richmond, CA general contractor) is named as general contractor for OUSD's McClymonds High School Modernization on HKIT's project page, matching the agenda's Richmond location and design-build team; 'Aten' is a typo of 'Alten'. Summary, website, phone and address are supported by the company site; the site footer says LLC while OUSD and HKIT say Inc., so the legal form is unverified but the OUSD records support the name.
